title: Directional Sharpen
description: Unsharp mask along a single direction on the GPU. Pick a fixed angle to undo motion blur or shake along that line, or sharpen across edges so each pixel follows its own brightness gradient: edges get crisper without amplifying the noise that runs along them. Amount is audio-mappable. Works on the camera, a dropped clip, the demo, or the layers below in the Mixer/Patch.
